_metadata.description: RVA23U64 Extension Software Stack Coverage Matrix
_metadata.udb_source: riscv-unified-db spec/std/isa/profile/RVA23U64.yaml (inheritance chain: RVA20U64 -> RVA22U64 -> RVB23U64 -> RVA23U64)
_metadata.editorial_note: Sub-extensions implicitly required by a mandatory umbrella extension are omitted: Zaamo/Zalrsc (subsets of A); Zca/Zcd (subsets of C); Zve32f, Zve32x, Zve64d, Zve64f, Zve64x, Zvl32b, Zvl64b, Zvl128b (subsets of V); Zvkb (implied by Zvbb). They appear in the UDB-generated cfg flat list but do not drive distinct software-stack work beyond their umbrella. Zcf is similarly a sub-component of compressed FP and is not separately optional in the profile source.

layer_definitions.none: No new instructions. Platform property guarantee only - hardware must meet this constraint, but software (compiler, kernel, userspace) needs no changes.
layer_definitions.compiler: Has ISA instructions that the compiler can auto-generate when -march enables the extension. No kernel or userspace library changes needed.
layer_definitions.kernel: Requires kernel changes (e.g., page table semantics, signal handling, perf subsystem). Userspace is largely transparent.
layer_definitions.userspace: Requires userspace runtime library changes (glibc, OpenSSL, etc.) beyond what the compiler provides.
layer_definitions.full_stack: Impacts the entire stack: kernel, compiler, and userspace libraries all need changes.

mandatory.name: I
mandatory.description: Base 64-bit integer instructions
mandatory.layer_note: Base ISA, always present.

mandatory.name: M
mandatory.description: Hardware integer multiplication and division
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler generates MUL/DIV. No kernel/userspace changes needed.

mandatory.name: A
mandatory.description: Load-reserved/store-conditional and atomic memory operations
mandatory.layer_note: glibc pthread/futex implementations use LR/SC and AMOs directly.

mandatory.name: F
mandatory.description: 32-bit IEEE 754 floating-point
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler generates FP instructions; kernel saves/restores FP state in signal handling; glibc FP ABI.

mandatory.name: D
mandatory.description: 64-bit IEEE 754 floating-point
mandatory.layer_note: Same as F but for 64-bit. Signal frame, ptrace, glibc ABI all affected.

mandatory.name: C
mandatory.description: 16-bit compressed instruction encoding
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler emits C instructions automatically when enabled. Kernel jump labels handle mixed 16/32-bit.

mandatory.name: B
mandatory.description: Shorthand for Zba+Zbb+Zbs
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler auto-generates bit manipulation instructions. No kernel/userspace changes needed.

mandatory.name: U
mandatory.description: User-mode privilege specification
mandatory.layer_note: Privilege architecture. Defines U-mode. Software implication: trap handling, syscall convention.

mandatory.name: V
mandatory.description: SIMD vector extension with configurable register width
mandatory.layer_note: Heaviest extension for distro adoption. Kernel: sigcontext vector state save/restore, ptrace, fork/exec. Userspace: glibc vector ABI, OpenSSL/libc optimized routines. Heterogeneous VLEN on SMP is rejected by kernel.

mandatory.name: Supm
mandatory.description: Pointer masking available in user mode (per UDB: 'execution environment' announcement; the underlying CSR control lives in Smnpm/Ssnpm)
mandatory.layer_note: Kernel side: configures S/Smnpm/Ssnpm CSR fields, exposes opt-in to userspace via prctl(PR_SET_TAGGED_ADDR_CTRL) (mirroring Arm TBI/MTE), saves/restores PMLEN across context switch, plumbs ptrace. Userspace side: pointer-tagging libraries (HWASan, MTE-style allocators, GC-style runtimes) consume tagged pointers; glibc must honor the masked-pointer ABI on syscalls. Analogous to Arm's TBI/MTE, which is universally treated as full-stack rather than kernel-only.

mandatory.name: Za64rs
mandatory.description: Reservation sets contiguous, aligned, ≤64 bytes
mandatory.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Software-transparent hardware constraint on LR/SC reservation granularity.

mandatory.name: Za128rs
mandatory.description: Reservation sets contiguous, aligned, ≤128 bytes
mandatory.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Relaxes Za64rs constraint.

mandatory.name: Zawrs
mandatory.description: WRS.STO / WRS.NTO instructions for low-power polling loops
mandatory.layer_note: glibc futex implementation can use WRS for efficient waiting. LLVM only has assembly support (no pattern matching).

mandatory.name: Zba
mandatory.description: Address generation instructions (sh1add, sh2add, sh3add, etc.)
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler auto-generates for address calculations. Transparent to kernel/userspace.

mandatory.name: Zbb
mandatory.description: Count leading/trailing zeros, bit reverse, or-combine, etc.
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler pattern-matches idioms (e.g., __builtin_ctz → ctz). Transparent.

mandatory.name: Zbs
mandatory.description: Bit manipulation on single bits (bset, bclr, binv, bext)
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler auto-generates. Transparent.

mandatory.name: Zcb
mandatory.description: Simple 16-bit compressed instructions for code size savings
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler auto-generates C-extension alternatives for common instructions. Pure code-size optimization.

mandatory.name: Zcmop
mandatory.description: 8 reserved 16-bit encodings for future MOP redefinition
mandatory.layer_note: Currently defined as NOPs (write zero to x[rd]). Reserved for future redefinition. No functional impact today.

mandatory.name: Zimop
mandatory.description: 32-bit encodings reserved for future instruction redefinition
mandatory.layer_note: Currently defined as NOPs. Reserved for future redefinition. No functional impact today.

mandatory.name: Zfa
mandatory.description: FP immediate loads, fmin/fmax, round-to-int, quiet comparisons, etc.
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler auto-generates new FP instructions. No new state to save/restore.

mandatory.name: Zfhmin
mandatory.description: Minimal IEEE 754 half-precision: load/store and conversions to/from single (and double if D present)
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler emits flh/fsh/fmv.x.h/fmv.h.x/fcvt.{s,d}.h/fcvt.h.{s,d} when -march enables Zfhmin. Uses existing F-register file: no new architectural state, so no kernel signal-frame or glibc ABI changes beyond what F already requires.

mandatory.name: Zic64b
mandatory.description: Cache blocks must be 64 bytes, naturally aligned
mandatory.layer_note: Platform property. No new instructions. Kernel: L1_CACHE_BYTES, DMA alignment, data structure layout. Device Tree provides cache block sizes.

mandatory.name: Zicbom
mandatory.description: CBO.CLEAN / CBO.FLUSH / CBO.INVAL instructions
mandatory.layer_note: Kernel uses for cache management (DMA ops, page table maintenance). LLVM only has assembly support. Userspace can use via __builtin_riscv_cache_* but mainly kernel concern.

mandatory.name: Zicbop
mandatory.description: PREFETCH.R / PREFETCH.W / PREFETCH.I instructions
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler can auto-generate prefetch instructions. Also usable via __builtin_prefetch. Transparent to kernel.

mandatory.name: Zicboz
mandatory.description: CBO.ZERO instruction for zeroing cache blocks
mandatory.layer_note: Kernel uses cbo.zero for fast page clearing AND must set senvcfg.CBZE to authorize U-mode execution (cbo.zero traps as illegal in U-mode while the bit is 0). Once enabled, userspace runtime (glibc memset, libc clear primitives) can issue cbo.zero directly. LLVM has assembly support only - no auto-generation. Linux exposes the capability via the riscv_hwprobe vDSO/syscall (block size in RISCV_HWPROBE_KEY_ZICBOZ_BLOCK_SIZE).

mandatory.name: Ziccamoa
mandatory.description: Cacheable coherent memory must support all A-extension AMOs
mandatory.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Software-transparent hardware memory system constraint.

mandatory.name: Ziccif
mandatory.description: Instruction fetches of aligned power-of-2 sizes are atomic
mandatory.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Software-transparent.

mandatory.name: Zicclsm
mandatory.description: Misaligned loads/stores to cacheable coherent memory must work
mandatory.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Note: misaligned may be extremely slow - software should not rely on it for performance.

mandatory.name: Ziccrse
mandatory.description: Memory system guarantees forward progress on LR/SC sequences
mandatory.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Software-transparent.

mandatory.name: Zicntr
mandatory.description: CYCLE, TIME, and INSTRET CSRs
mandatory.layer_note: No new instructions. CSRs for performance counters. LLVM accepts unconditionally for backward compat.

mandatory.name: Zicond
mandatory.description: CZERO.EQZ / CZERO.NEZ conditional select instructions
mandatory.layer_note: Compiler pattern-matches conditional idioms and generates CZERO. Transparent.

mandatory.name: Zicsr
mandatory.description: CSRRW/CSRRS/CSRRC/CSRRWI/CSRRSI/CSRRCI instructions
mandatory.layer_note: CSR access instructions. LLVM accepts unconditionally for backward compat.

mandatory.name: Zihintntl
mandatory.description: HINT.NTL.P1/PALL/S1/SALL hint instructions
mandatory.layer_note: Hint instructions - architecture-defined NOPs. Hardware may use for cache policy hints. Software-transparent.

mandatory.name: Zihintpause
mandatory.description: PAUSE hint instruction for spin-wait loops
mandatory.layer_note: glibc spinlocks and futex can use PAUSE for efficient spinning. LLVM only has assembly support.

mandatory.name: Zihpm
mandatory.description: Hardware performance counter CSRs (hpmcounter3..31, etc.)
mandatory.layer_note: No new instructions. Kernel perf subsystem needs to expose hpmcounter CSRs to userspace via perf_events.

mandatory.name: Zkt
mandatory.description: Attests data-independent execution time for a safe instruction subset
mandatory.layer_note: No new instructions. Hardware property guarantee for cryptographic constant-time. Software-transparent.

mandatory.name: Zvbb
mandatory.description: Vector versions of Zbb instructions (vrol, vror, vbrev, etc.)
mandatory.layer_note: Requires V extension. Compiler can generate; kernel must handle in V sigcontext. Crypto libraries benefit.

mandatory.name: Zvfhmin
mandatory.description: Vector conversions between half and single precision
mandatory.layer_note: Requires V extension. Adds vfwcvt.f.f.v and vfwcvt.f.x.v. No new register state beyond V.

mandatory.name: Zvkt
mandatory.description: Vector instructions must execute with data-independent latency
mandatory.layer_note: No new instructions. Hardware property guarantee for vector crypto constant-time. Software-transparent.

optional.name: Zabha
optional.layer_note: glibc pthread can use for byte/halfword atomic ops. Kernel futex optimization.

optional.name: Zacas
optional.llvm_status: Supported (no amocas.q on RV64 due to ABI)
optional.layer_note: glibc pthread and lock-free data structures benefit. LLVM won't generate amocas.q on RV64 (ABI compat).

optional.name: Zama16b
optional.description: Misaligned AMOs within 16B boundary are atomic
optional.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Not yet in Linux kernel cpufeature.

optional.name: Zbc
optional.layer_note: Used by CRC and crypto libraries. Compiler intrinsics; no auto-generation.

optional.name: Zfbfmin
optional.layer_note: ML/AI workloads. Compiler can generate BF16 conversion instructions.

optional.name: Zfh
optional.layer_note: Superset of Zfhmin. Adds FP16 arithmetic. Compiler generates; kernel saves FP16 state in signal frame.

optional.name: Ziccamoc
optional.description: Cacheable coherent memory supports non-arithmetic AMOs
optional.layer_note: Platform property guarantee. No new instructions. Not yet in Linux kernel.

optional.name: Zicfilp
optional.description: Indirect branch tracking via landing pad labels
optional.layer_note: Compiler generates shadow landing pads; kernel manages enforcement state; ELF binary format changes; distro must handle mixed CFI/non-CFI binaries. LLVM still experimental.

optional.name: Zicfiss
optional.description: Hardware shadow stack for return address protection
optional.layer_note: Kernel manages shadow stack memory; signal handling must save/restore SSP; ptrace needs new regset; glibc must be compiled with shadow stack support. LLVM still experimental.

optional.name: Zvbc
optional.description: Vector CLMUL for cryptography (GHASH, CRC, ECC)
optional.layer_note: OpenSSL/GnuTLS acceleration. Compiler intrinsics only (no pattern matching in GCC or LLVM). Requires V.

optional.name: Zvfbfmin
optional.layer_note: ML/AI vector workloads. Requires V. No new register state.

optional.name: Zvfbfwma
optional.layer_note: ML/AI vector workloads. Requires V + Zvfbfmin. No new register state.

optional.name: Zvfh
optional.layer_note: Superset of Zvfhmin. Adds vector FP16 arithmetic. Requires V.

optional.name: Zvkng
optional.description: Shorthand for Zvkn + Zvkg (NIST suite + GCM)
optional.layer_note: OpenSSL/GnuTLS AES-GCM acceleration. Compiler intrinsics only. Requires V.

optional.name: Zvksg
optional.description: Shorthand for Zvks + Zvkg (SM suite + GCM)
optional.layer_note: OpenSSL/GnuTLS SM4-GCM acceleration. Compiler intrinsics only. Requires V.

by_layer.compiler: Compiler auto-generates - march enables, no other changes
by_layer.kernel: Kernel adaptation needed - userspace largely transparent
by_layer.full_stack: Kernel + compiler + userspace libraries all need work
